lines.zh: 低吼声中水波荡漾
lines.en: Rumble ripples through the water

lines.zh: 背帆在水面轻轻摆动
lines.en: Sail sways gently on the surface

lines.zh: 缓慢前行，水草摩擦身体
lines.en: Slowly moves, brushing against water plants

lines.zh: 吞下一大口冷水
lines.en: Takes a large gulp of cold water

lines.zh: 水面泛起阵阵波纹
lines.en: Water ripples in waves

lines.zh: 尾巴在水中轻轻摆动
lines.en: Tail swishes softly in the water

lines.zh: 发出嘶嘶声，前进
lines.en: Hisses and moves forward

lines.zh: 用利爪拨开水面
lines.en: Splays claws, parting water

lines.zh: 低头潜入水中觅食
lines.en: Lowers head to dive into water for food

lines.zh: 水面泛起一圈圈涟漪
lines.en: Water rings ripple outward

lines.zh: 上了岸，步子就沉了
lines.en: On land my steps turn heavy.

lines.zh: 水一深，我立刻变快
lines.en: Deeper water, and I am suddenly fast.

lines.zh: 长尾在水里划出直线
lines.en: My long tail cuts a straight line in the water.

lines.zh: 沿着河岸慢慢巡视
lines.en: I patrol slowly along the riverbank.

lines.zh: 背帆静静浮在水面
lines.en: Sail floats calmly on the surface

lines.zh: 我把背帆露出水面，缓缓滑行。
lines.en: I keep my sail above the water and glide.

lines.zh: 在水中舒展身体
lines.en: Exhibits its body in the water

lines.zh: 偶尔抬头环视四周
lines.en: Occasionally lifts head to look around

lines.zh: 用鼻孔呼吸水面的空气
lines.en: Breathes air through nasal passages

lines.zh: 偶尔吐出水泡
lines.en: Spits out bubbles occasionally

lines.zh: 背上的皮肤似乎在呼吸
lines.en: Skin on back seems to breathe

lines.zh: 缓慢地扇动背帆
lines.en: Slowly flaps its sail

lines.zh: 享受着水中的宁静
lines.en: Enjoys the water's tranquility

lines.zh: 偶尔低头看看
lines.en: Occasionally lowers head to look

lines.zh: 只把眼睛露在水面
lines.en: Only my eyes show above the water.

lines.zh: 背帆像一面旧船帆
lines.en: My sail stands like an old ship's canvas.

lines.zh: 在浅滩上晾干鳞甲
lines.en: I dry my scales on the shallows.

lines.zh: 鼻孔慢慢喷出水汽
lines.en: My nostrils puff out mist, slow and steady.

lines.zh: 盯住玩家，眼中充满威胁
lines.en: Locks eyes on the player, full of threat

lines.zh: 张开大口，露出锋利牙齿
lines.en: Opens mouth, revealing sharp teeth

lines.zh: 缓缓转向玩家的方向
lines.en: Slowly turns towards the player

lines.zh: 鼻孔中喷出一股冷气
lines.en: Exhales a cold puff from the nostrils

lines.zh: 鼻孔张开，窥探玩家
lines.en: Nostrils flare, eyeing the player

lines.zh: 背上鳞片轻轻颤动
lines.en: Scales on back vibrate lightly

lines.zh: 耳朵后方的褶皱似乎在注意
lines.en: Folds behind ears seem attentive

lines.zh: 背帆在注视中轻微颤动
lines.en: Sail vibrates slightly in attention

lines.zh: 全身肌肉紧绷，准备攻击
lines.en: Muscles tense, ready for attack

lines.zh: 发出低沉的咆哮，准备行动
lines.en: Rumbles, ready to act

lines.zh: 从水下抬眼看你
lines.en: I raise my eyes to you from under the water.

lines.zh: 你没有我一半大
lines.en: You are not half my size.

lines.zh: 脊棘受伤了，发出痛苦的吼叫。
lines.en: Spinosaurus is hurt and lets out a painful roar.

lines.zh: 脊棘受了伤，动作变得迟缓。
lines.en: Spinosaurus is injured and moves more slowly.

lines.zh: 脊棘受了伤，尾巴在地上扫来扫去。
lines.en: Spinosaurus is hurt, swishing its tail on the ground.

lines.zh: 脊棘受了伤，声音变得低沉。
lines.en: Spinosaurus is hurt, and its voice sounds low.

lines.zh: 脊棘受伤了，流着血。
lines.en: Spinosaurus is hurt, bleeding heavily.

lines.zh: 脊棘受了伤，游得比平时慢。
lines.en: Spinosaurus is hurt, swimming slower than usual.

lines.zh: 脊棘受了伤，不再追赶猎物。
lines.en: Spinosaurus is hurt, no longer chasing prey.

lines.zh: 脊棘受了伤，身体摇摇晃晃。
lines.en: Spinosaurus is hurt, its body wobbles.

lines.zh: 脊棘受了伤，看起来很虚弱。
lines.en: Spinosaurus is hurt, looking very weak.

lines.zh: 脊棘受了伤，行动越来越迟缓。
lines.en: Spinosaurus is hurt, its movements are slowing down.

lines.zh: 你靠近得太近了，棘龙低吼警告。
lines.en: You've come too close, Spinosaurus warns with a low growl.

lines.zh: 棘龙张开巨大的嘴，露出锋利的牙齿。
lines.en: Spinosaurus opens its massive mouth, revealing sharp teeth.

lines.zh: 棘龙盯着水面，寻找猎物。
lines.en: Spinosaurus stares at the water, searching for prey.

lines.zh: 它轻轻摇摆着长尾巴，警告潜在威胁。
lines.en: It sways its long tail, warning potential threats.

lines.zh: 棘龙吐出一团水柱，吓退了靠近的猎人。
lines.en: Spinosaurus spits a jet of water, intimidating the approaching hunter.

lines.zh: 棘龙的背帆随风轻轻摇动。
lines.en: Spinosaurus' sail flutters in the breeze.

lines.zh: 它的长颈帮助它在水中猎食。
lines.en: Its long neck aids in hunting underwater.

lines.zh: 棘龙潜入水中，寻找猎物。
lines.en: Spinosaurus dives into the water, searching for prey.

lines.zh: 它那独特的背帆是它的标志。
lines.en: Its distinctive sail is its mark.

lines.zh: 棘龙开始在岸边散步，寻找食物。
lines.en: Spinosaurus begins to walk along the shore, searching for food.

lines.zh: 棘龙突然冲向水面，与你相撞。
lines.en: Spinosaurus suddenly rushes towards the water, colliding with you.

lines.zh: 棘龙的尾巴扫过，差点击中目标。
lines.en: Spinosaurus' tail swings past, narrowly missing its target.

lines.zh: 它的身体撞击力量惊人。
lines.en: The force of its body collisions is tremendous.

lines.zh: 棘龙用尾部撞击水面，制造巨响。
lines.en: Spinosaurus slams its tail into the water, creating a loud sound.

lines.zh: 它的背部坚硬，撞击效果显著。
lines.en: Its back is hard, making significant impacts.

lines.zh: 棘龙用头撞击岩石，发出沉重的声响。
lines.en: Spinosaurus slams its head into the rock, making a heavy sound.

lines.zh: 它用尾巴撞击，试图击退敌人。
lines.en: It uses its tail to strike, trying to repel enemies.

lines.zh: 棘龙的撞击力强大，能击退对手。
lines.en: Spinosaurus' powerful collisions can repel opponents.

lines.zh: 它的撞击速度很快，难以躲避。
lines.en: Its fast collisions are hard to avoid.

lines.zh: 棘龙用身体撞击，阻止你前进。
lines.en: Spinosaurus uses its body to collide and stop your advance.

lines.zh: 棘龙的叫声唤起了同类的注意。
lines.en: Spinosaurus' call draws attention from its mate.

lines.zh: 棘龙发出低沉的求偶叫声。
lines.en: Spinosaurus emits a low, mating call.

lines.zh: 它用头敲击地面，求偶。
lines.en: It uses its head to tap the ground, seeking a mate.

lines.zh: 棘龙的背帆在求偶时展开。
lines.en: Spinosaurus' sail spreads during mating displays.

lines.zh: 它用尾巴在水面上敲击，展示力量。
lines.en: It uses its tail to tap on the water, showing its strength.

lines.zh: 棘龙的求偶行为吸引其他个体。
lines.en: Spinosaurus' mating behavior attracts other individuals.

lines.zh: 它用身体摩擦来吸引伴侣。
lines.en: It uses its body to rub and attract a mate.

lines.zh: 棘龙发出求偶信号，展示它的领地。
lines.en: Spinosaurus emits a mating signal, displaying its territory.

lines.zh: 它用声音和动作吸引配偶。
lines.en: It uses sounds and actions to attract a mate.

lines.zh: 棘龙发出求偶叫声，展示它的存在。
lines.en: Spinosaurus emits a mating call, showcasing its presence.

lines.zh: 背上巨大的帆在阳光下闪耀。
lines.en: The huge sail glimmers in the sun.

lines.zh: 陆地上的缓慢步伐，水中的迅捷游动。
lines.en: Slow on land, swift in the water.

lines.zh: 只需一击，便能终结对手。
lines.en: One strike, and the battle's done.

lines.zh: 我的背帆是胜利的象征。
lines.en: My sail marks my victory.

lines.zh: 靠近些，我不会轻易攻击。
lines.en: Come closer, I won't attack lightly.

lines.zh: 水中才是我的战场。
lines.en: Water's where I fight.

lines.zh: 生肉，我的战利品。
lines.en: Raw meat, my trophy.

lines.zh: 我只需静静等待猎物。
lines.en: I wait for my prey to come.

lines.zh: 背上的鳞片如锋利的刀片。
lines.en: My scales are sharp as blades.

lines.zh: 适应深水，我的栖息地。
lines.en: I thrive in deep waters.

lines.zh: 感觉到了你的气息，猎物。
lines.en: I sense your presence, prey.

lines.zh: 你在岸边，我记住了位置。
lines.en: You are on the bank; I have your position.

lines.zh: 你的位置，我了如指掌。
lines.en: I know your position well.

lines.zh: 耐心等待，猎物将被捕捉。
lines.en: Patience, and prey will be caught.

lines.zh: 背帆划开水面，我朝你来。
lines.en: My sail cuts the water; I come for you.

lines.zh: 追踪每一个可能的猎物。
lines.en: I follow every lead.

lines.zh: 你的动作，我早已注意。
lines.en: Your movements, I've noticed.

lines.zh: 水里你可跑不过我。
lines.en: You can't outswim me.

lines.zh: 你将成为我的美食。
lines.en: You'll be my meal.

lines.zh: 你的死亡，近在咫尺。
lines.en: Your death is close.

lines.zh: 水里的影子比岸上多
lines.en: More shadows in the water than on the bank.

lines.zh: 那条鱼够我吃一顿
lines.en: That fish will do for one meal.

lines.zh: 体型比我小就够了
lines.en: Smaller than me is all it takes.

lines.zh: 我贴着河底跟上去
lines.en: I follow along the riverbed.

lines.zh: 锁定目标，我的攻击将至。
lines.en: Target locked, attack coming.

lines.zh: 感受我的力量吧，猎物。
lines.en: Feel my power, prey.

lines.zh: 我的攻击无法避免。
lines.en: My attack is inevitable.

lines.zh: 现在，就是你死亡之时。
lines.en: Now, is your time to die.

lines.zh: 你将品尝我的利爪。
lines.en: You'll taste my claws.

lines.zh: 我的攻击，无法抵挡。
lines.en: My attack can't be stopped.

lines.zh: 感受我背上的力量吧。
lines.en: Feel the power of my back.

lines.zh: 你将为我的攻击付出代价。
lines.en: You'll pay for my attack.

lines.zh: 我的利齿，将撕裂你。
lines.en: My teeth will tear you apart.

lines.zh: 你站在水边，那就是我的地盘。
lines.en: Standing at the water's edge — that is my ground.

lines.zh: 在水里，一击就够
lines.en: In the water, one strike is enough.

lines.zh: 把它往深水赶
lines.en: I herd it toward the deep.

lines.zh: 等它离岸再远些
lines.en: Wait until it is farther from shore.

lines.zh: 大嘴已经张到位
lines.en: My jaws are set and ready.

lines.zh: 河底的泥替我藏身
lines.en: The river mud hides me.

lines.zh: 挥动巨大颚，吞下猎物！
lines.en: Swing huge jaws, swallow prey!

lines.zh: 脊背划破水面，惊起水花四溅！
lines.en: Back ripples the water's surface, splashing everywhere!

lines.zh: 用利爪抓住猎物，一击毙命！
lines.en: Claw grabs the prey, one strike ends it!

lines.zh: 颚中磨碎骨骼，发出咔嚓声！
lines.en: Jaws crush bones, making cracking sounds!

lines.zh: 用尾巴拍打水面，吓退敌人！
lines.en: Tail slaps water, scaring off enemies!

lines.zh: 喷出一连串泡沫，攻击对手！
lines.en: Spit out a string of bubbles, attacking opponents!

lines.zh: 用背上的刺威胁敌人！
lines.en: Threaten enemies with back spines!

lines.zh: 低吼，向猎物示威！
lines.en: Roar low, intimidating prey!

lines.zh: 用颚紧紧咬住目标！
lines.en: Jaws clamp tightly on the target!

lines.zh: 跃出水面，用颚攻击！
lines.en: Leap from water, attack with jaws!

lines.zh: 一口下去，水面合拢！
lines.en: One bite, and the water closes over!

lines.zh: 利齿锁住它的脊背！
lines.en: My teeth lock onto its spine!

lines.zh: 在水中，我从不失手！
lines.en: In the water, I never miss!

lines.zh: 整副身躯压下去！
lines.en: My whole bulk comes down!

lines.zh: 嘶嘶声中，棘龙从水中升起！
lines.en: Rumbling, spinosaurus emerges from water!

lines.zh: 潜入水中，棘龙悄悄接近！
lines.en: Submerge, spinosaurus sneaks close!

lines.zh: 在河流边缘，棘龙慢慢出现！
lines.en: By riverbanks, spinosaurus slowly appears!

lines.zh: 水面下，棘龙潜伏伺机！
lines.en: Underwater, spinosaurus waits!

lines.zh: 岸边的树丛中，棘龙悄然现身！
lines.en: From bushes by the shore, spinosaurus appears!

lines.zh: 水面上方，棘龙缓缓游动！
lines.en: Above the water, spinosaurus moves slowly!

lines.zh: 棘龙从泥沼中缓缓走出！
lines.en: Spinosaurus wades out of mud!

lines.zh: 在河边，棘龙悠然现身！
lines.en: At the riverbank, spinosaurus appears leisurely!

lines.zh: 水中，棘龙无声地潜行！
lines.en: Water, spinosaurus moves silently!

lines.zh: 棘龙缓缓游入水中觅食！
lines.en: Spinosaurus slowly enters the water to hunt!

lines.zh: 河湾深处浮起背帆
lines.en: A sail rises in the deep of the river bend.

lines.zh: 我从淤泥里站起身
lines.en: I rise up out of the silt.

lines.zh: 岸边的芦苇晃了一下
lines.en: The reeds on the bank sway once.

lines.zh: 水面裂开，我探出头
lines.en: The surface breaks; I lift my head.

lines.zh: 这条河归我巡了
lines.en: This river answers to my patrol now.

lines.zh: 半身在水，半身在外
lines.en: Half in the water, half out.

lines.zh: 我的影子盖住浅滩
lines.en: My shadow covers the shallows.

lines.zh: 沼泽边传来沉重的脚步
lines.en: Heavy steps come from the marsh edge.

lines.zh: 脊棘被火焰烧伤，发出痛苦的吼叫。
lines.en: Spinosaurus is burned by fire, letting out a painful roar.

lines.zh: 脊棘从高处摔落，身上多处受伤。
lines.en: Spinosaurus fell from a high place, sustaining multiple injuries.

lines.zh: 脊棘溺水了，挣扎着游上岸。
lines.en: Spinosaurus is drowning, struggling to swim ashore.

lines.zh: 脊棘被爆炸震伤，声音嘶哑。
lines.en: Spinosaurus is injured by the explosion, its voice is hoarse.

lines.zh: 脊棘被投射物击中，身体摇晃。
lines.en: Spinosaurus is hit by a projectile, its body shakes.

lines.zh: 脊棘被魔法攻击，身上冒起黑烟。
lines.en: Spinosaurus is hit by magic, smoke rises from its body.

lines.zh: 脊棘长时间未进食，身体虚弱。
lines.en: Spinosaurus hasn't eaten for a long time, it's weak.

lines.zh: 脊棘被雷击中，身上冒出黑烟。
lines.en: Spinosaurus is hit by lightning, black smoke rises from its body.

lines.zh: 脊棘跌入虚空中，身体剧烈摇晃。
lines.en: Spinosaurus falls into the void, its body shakes violently.
